aboutGame.title: What is EA SPORTS UFC 5?
paragraphs: EA SPORTS UFC 5 is a mixed martial arts fighting game developed by EA Vancouver and published by Electronic Arts. Built on the Frostbite engine, it brings real-time damage, seamless submissions, and expanded striking to PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S.

The game spans Career Mode, Online Career, Fight Week, and ranked competition, with a roster of past and present UFC fighters across 11 weight divisions. Create a fighter, choose from five fighting styles, develop stand-up and submission skills, and chase championship glory in the Octagon.

modules.name: EA SPORTS UFC 5 Controls Guide
modules.description: Master PlayStation and Xbox inputs for striking, blocking, movement, takedowns, clinch grappling, submissions, and ground defense.

highlights.label: Strike
highlights.detail: Xbox X/Y or PS5 Square/Triangle throw left and right punches.

highlights.label: Block
highlights.detail: Hold RT/R2 for high block; add LT/L2 for low block and timed leg catch.

highlights.label: Takedown
highlights.detail: Tap LT + X + A on Xbox or L2 + Square + X on PS5 for a single-leg takedown.

highlights.label: Submit
highlights.detail: From the clinch, use LT + RB + X/Y on Xbox or L2 + R1 + Square/Triangle on PS5.

modules.name: EA SPORTS UFC 5 Beginner Guide
modules.description: Learn the fundamentals of striking, grappling, stamina management, defense, and effective combinations before your first fights.

highlights.detail: Start in the Learn tab and use the Training Manual to review essential movement and attack inputs.
Practice basic strikes and combinations in Practice Mode before entering Career Mode.
Earn XP in online and offline matches, then complete challenge-board objectives for larger bursts.
Finish each weekly Punch Card before it expires to collect UFC Coins and progression rewards.
Create a fighter, choose a weight class and fighter type, then improve stand-up and submission skills.

modules.name: EA SPORTS UFC 5 Career Mode Guide
modules.description: Create a fighter, choose a fighting style, raise attributes, and build a path from unknown amateur to UFC champion.

highlights.detail: Create a custom fighter and adjust appearance details such as hair, eye color, and tattoos.
Pick a weight class and one of five fighting styles: Kickboxer, Boxer, MMA, Wrestler, or Jiu-jitsu.
Enter Career Mode under Coach Davis and use the Training Manual plus Practice Mode to sharpen your inputs.
Earn Punch Card XP through online and offline matches and challenge-board objectives.
Spend UFC Coins on gear and customization, and use Evolution Points to raise stand-up and submission stats.

items.question: What is EA SPORTS UFC 5?
items.answer: EA SPORTS UFC 5 is a mixed martial arts fighting game from EA Vancouver and Electronic Arts. It features real-time damage, seamless submissions, Career Mode, Online Career, Fight Week, and a roster spanning 11 weight divisions on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.

items.question: How do Punch Cards work in EA SPORTS UFC 5?
items.answer: EA SPORTS UFC 5 awards XP for online and offline matches and challenge-board objectives. XP levels up the weekly Punch Card and unlocks rewards, but each card expires, so finish its levels before the card rotates out.

items.question: How do I earn UFC Coins in EA SPORTS UFC 5?
items.answer: Earn UFC Coins in EA SPORTS UFC 5 through Punch Card rewards and Fight Week contracts. Spend them in the Store on gear, accessories, emotes, playercard customizations, and sometimes Alter Egos.

items.question: What is the best way to start EA SPORTS UFC 5?
items.answer: Begin EA SPORTS UFC 5 in the Learn tab, study the Training Manual, and practice essential inputs in Practice Mode. Then choose a fighter type, play both online and offline matches for Punch Card XP, and develop stand-up and submission skills in Career Mode.

items.question: Does EA SPORTS UFC 5 have online ranked play?
items.answer: EA SPORTS UFC 5 Online Career Mode uses skill-based matchmaking, division progression, and title chases across four divisions. Online matches also award XP toward the Punch Card, with different amounts from offline play.
